notes.title: Full Release build
notes.notes:
With the addition of of the tutorial levels, taking the level count to 200 + 10 tutorial levels.
It's all done and ready.
Hopefully you enjoy it.

NB. This is meant to be a hard game so expect after level 60 or so to have to puzzle out and think your way around the problems.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes: Added some tutorial levels in at the start so 10 more levels total to 200.

notes.title: Release 1.28 Crabtastic
notes.notes:
Another 10 levels, new enemy, the crab. 
170/200 levels now at first pass.
Some new visuals, few bugs stomped. 
Powers worked on a bit, some QOL getting nearer ready.

notes.title: Demo updated to alpha 1.25 version.
notes.notes:
I thought everything in the demo was fine till last Sunday when someone told me of the problem which related to dying and respawning.
A quick bug track later and I'm doing a facepalm ːsteamfacepalmː wondering how many people this annoyed.
Turns out I had a log string going to d:\downloads folder left in.
I have a d:\downloads folder on 2 of my machines, so I didn't notice anything even when testing on the steam build. My friend though noticed and thankfully I found it quickly and fixed it.

So here is the later version of the demo, hope you have fun ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Happy Holidays - Update To 1.24 Mushrooms and mummys!
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays!
120 levels now in with a further 10 hidden ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41127533/8e55dba36a59509189b42116811c29a47fb992d7.jpg[/img]

+20 levels
+2 new enemies (If you haven't guessed a mushroom and a mummy) ːlunar2019grinningpigː

Custom levels now defaults correctly and on difficulty selection, go back to change modes if you are continuing.

Couple of bug fixes as well.

notes.title: Release 1.22 A few levels more.
notes.notes:
Release 1.22

79 /200 levels. (+24 new levels), 10 moved to hidden.
Powers activated.
Dev panel added to main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41127533/8ff86b9bb3f2818521bba95d4788f6bc1c1141b5.png[/img]

The pace is picking up, the levels are now getting much harder.

Some levels require normal powers. ːLotusː
At the moment the powers require activation in order OR via the dev panel.
The dev panel can also unlock all levels, or you can view them in the editor.

The focus for the next release 1.23 is going to be levels and a couple of new enemies. ːcozycrashfishː
